summary: Environment A direct-binary proof that Phase 24.3.1 (quality-tier language-conditioning fix: SpeechEngine::transcribe_once now accepts a language_hint from the fast tier's own real per-window detection) is genuinely compiled into this rebuilt installer, with zero functional regression to every prior-phase Rust symbol.
gitCommitNote: This is the source tree commit (Phase 24.3.1's own commit) this rebuild was performed against. Phase 24.3.1 touches core/ai/src/speech_engine.rs (transcribe_once signature), ai/speech/src/whisper.rs (WhisperSpeechEngine's implementation + module docs), and apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs (QualityJob.language_hint, wired from segment.language through to transcribe_once). No frontend files, no migrations, no new commands/events. This is the fourth consecutive rebuild this session (following Phase 24.1's gitCommit 472b91a, Phase 24.2's gitCommit b668be5, and Phase 24.3's gitCommit c9f3ef0) - all four closed real gaps identified by continuing directly from the operator's own follow-up direction.

Every tripwire from Phase 24.3's own baseline (the most recent prior rebuild) was re-checked, including the one Phase 24.3 investigated and confirmed benign (retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context).
symbolRegressionCheck.tripwiresFromPriorPhasesDeviation: None. All 33 pre-existing tripwire symbols matched their Phase 24.3 baseline count exactly, including retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context (2, matching Phase 24.3's own investigated baseline - the two genuinely distinct functions sharing a short name, unchanged again this phase).

No new symbol names were introduced this phase to track as fresh tripwires.

frontendTextSearchLimitation: Not applicable this phase - Phase 24.3.1 touches zero frontend files (confirmed by `git show --stat` on the phase's own commit). npm run typecheck and npm run build were both run and passed clean against the unchanged frontend source, confirming nothing frontend-visible was affected.
architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero changes to any existing Tauri command's signature or behavior, zero changes to any existing event's payload shape, zero new migrations, zero new commands, zero new events.

The language_hint parameter only affects the one transcribe_once call it is passed to - WhisperSpeechEngine.requested_language (this instance's own set_language-configured default, governing every other decode) is never mutated by it.

When the fast tier reports no language for a window, language_hint is None and the quality tier falls back to exactly its Phase 24.3 prior behavior (self.requested_language) - this fix can only make the two tiers agree more often, never introduce a new disagreement.

Every prior-phase command and symbol remains present and unregressed - all 33 tripwires matched exactly, zero deviation this rebuild (an improvement over Phase 24.3's own rebuild, which had one investigated-and-confirmed-benign deviation).
